16:00 I can’t even believe how chilling this story is. I’ve always been fascinated by true crime, but this one really hit differently. It’s like something straight out of a thriller movie. The fact that Maryanne got away with so much for so long is beyond me. It honestly reminds me of a situation I had when I was younger—being around someone who seemed totally normal but just had this unsettling vibe. I never trusted my gut at the time, and looking back, I’m so glad I kept my distance.
People like Maryanne really make you question the nature of evil and how it can be hidden in plain sight. It’s so crazy that sometimes, the most dangerous people are the ones you least expect.
To everyone watching, stay alert and always trust your instincts. Sometimes the signs are there, but it takes someone with courage to speak up. Let’s keep looking out for each other and staying safe. Be aware, be kind, and keep those you love close. ❤
